title: Manifest
description: Root of `apps.yaml` — the declarative installation + configuration manifest.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version; bump + migrate on breaking changes.

BootstrapEntry.description: A bootstrap entry: either a bare step name (`"opencode"`) or a detailed form with hooks (`{ id: "opencode", hooks: { post-install: "..." } }`).

Execution.description: Parallel execution tuning for the install phase. `apps.yaml` is the source of truth for the dependency graph; this section tunes the engine that executes it (worker count + per lock-class concurrency).

locks.description: Per lock-class concurrency overrides, e.g. `{ mas: 4, go: 4 }`. Keys are lock classes (`brew`, `mas`, `gem`, `npm`, `pip`, `cargo`, `go`, `composer`, `toolchain`, `bootstrap`); `brew` is capped at 1 (concurrent `brew` invocations are unsupported by Homebrew).

max_jobs.description: Max parallel install units; 0 = number of available CPUs. Default 0.

Hooks.description: Lifecycle hook snippets run via `sh -c` through the exec seam. Each field is a shell snippet (may be multi-line). `post-install` fires whenever the unit ends up present (newly installed or already installed, no failures) so config converges; pre hooks fire ahead of their action. Snippets must be idempotency-preserving.

Install.description: Typed bootstrap steps are pure hook carriers (implementations live in `dotfiles-backends::bootstrap`, which runs no logic per step). Any step id is accepted; validation requires each entry to carry hooks.

bootstrap.description: Typed, idempotent setup steps (may carry post-install hooks).

execution.description: Parallel execution tuning for the install phase (the DAG engine).

require.description: Unified package list: every installable item as `driver:name` with optional version, label, requires, lock, and lifecycle hooks.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hook snippets executed via `sh -c` through the exec seam.

id.description: Canonical unit ID, e.g. `brew-formula:git`, `mas:1352778147`, `npm:prettier@3` (version suffix is sugar for the `version` field).

label.description: Human label, required for `mas:` entries (App Store display name).

lock.description: Resource-class override (default = the backend's own lock class).

requires.description: Unit IDs that must complete first, e.g. `["brew-formula:php"]`. See `crate::units` for the canonical `<prefix>:<name>` namespace.

version.description: Explicit version pin (e.g. `"3"` for npm, `"1.9.0"` for gem). For `npm:`/`pip:`/`go:` the same pin can be written as `id: "npm:prettier@3"`.

RequireEntry.description: A single entry in `install.require`: either a bare unit ID string (`"brew-formula:git"`) or a detailed map with version / hooks / edges.
